verdict.rationale: PlayCanvas uses standard JavaScript/ESM/TypeScript for scripting, which is productive and integrates with the full Engine API (component access, physics, graphics, etc.), and standard browser/Node debuggers (Chrome DevTools, VSCode) can attach since it's plain JS/TS running in the browser. However, the evidence pack never explicitly documents a dedicated in-Editor script debugger, breakpoint support, or debugging workflow guidance — only 'live editing' of scripts at runtime is mentioned, not step-through debugging. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a debugger/breakpoint workflow for scripts, confirmation that source maps work seamlessly for ESM scripts in the Editor, and independent developer accounts of the debugging experience.
